verdicts.reason: The two are almost pixel-identical; the only difference is that B's quote mark is slightly larger. Both share the same flaws. The can sits high and off-centre in the circle, leaving the lower half empty. The SOLSTICE logo is squeezed in beside the attribution, so it competes with it instead of being placed as a separate brand mark. There is also a large dead gap between the quote mark and the quote text.
